notes.label: Collect a gem beyond a vertical portcullis using three connected functional stages: expose the latch input, retract the ceiling-pinned latch, and lift the portcullis.
notes.goal: Collect a gem beyond a vertical portcullis using three connected functional stages: expose the latch input, retract the ceiling-pinned latch, and lift the portcullis.
notes.change: Use an elbow-shaped preparation block in a side access neck, a separate bent horizontal latch beneath a ceiling tooth, and a vertical gate in a constrained guide. All groups remain supported; the preparation uses parking instead of disposal.
notes.reason: The elbow must move to expose the latch's pushing face. The latch contacts the gate and transmits its upward push into a fixed ceiling. Retracting the latch changes that contact; the gate must then lift to connect the starting chamber to the gem corridor.
expectedChecks: Each role is necessary for the complete gem goal.
Preparation is required before the first latch-left opportunity.
Latch-left motion is required before the first gate-up opportunity.
The gate must move after relative offset changes.
Removing the same ceiling tooth admits the blocked gate push and a complete bypass without latch-left motion.
The full route runs through the official 3D Play handler.

notes.label: Deliver Ceiling Tooth as a structurally verified complex Boundary Stagger room with an observed browser replay.
notes.goal: Deliver Ceiling Tooth as a structurally verified complex Boundary Stagger room with an observed browser replay.
notes.change: Retained the first geometry because all 23 complex checks and the full browser playtest passed. Saved the 24-input, 25-frame observed replay and the complete local delivery guide.
notes.reason: The exclusion searches establish the three-stage dependency. Removing the ceiling tooth enables the same blocked gate push and a complete bypass without retracting the latch, with no change to the initial frozen walking region. No geometry revision was warranted.
expectedChecks: The final design, build, structural report, and replay fingerprints agree.
The authoring record is sealed before entering the serialized publication queue.
Human difficulty remains unranked; automated author playtest is disclosed.
